question: Which repository had the biggest jump in activity, and what was discussed at the time?
sql:
WITH activity AS (
  SELECT
    repo_slug,
    year_month,
    commits,
    commits - LAG(commits) OVER (PARTITION BY repo_slug ORDER BY year_month) AS commit_jump
  FROM v_repo_activity
),
top_jump AS (
  SELECT repo_slug, year_month, commit_jump
  FROM activity
  ORDER BY commit_jump DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  t.repo_slug,
  t.year_month,
  t.commit_jump AS commit_jump,
  array_agg(c.subject) AS commit_subjects
FROM top_jump t
JOIN v_commit c
  ON c.repo_slug = t.repo_slug
  AND c.year_month = t.year_month
GROUP BY t.repo_slug, t.year_month, t.commit_jump
